title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode lets users chat without tagging it
notes: claim 55: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says existing controls cover availability only and that the documented levers govern Facilitator as a whole. Microsoft also documents retention, auditing and a tenant-wide control for AI-generated notes; the roadmap dates and the stated gaps specific to follow-up mode are otherwise supported.

claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of controls[1].note with 'This is a general Teams app control; its reference does not confirm that it manages built-in Facilitator.' Preserve the warning about the conflicting Boolean examples and the different Built-in Teams agents page.
